summary: Legs B day, so extra whole grain pasta at dinner for carbs. Breakfast was skipped recently, so it's simplified to four grab-and-go items (no bowls, toasting or peeling) instead of the usual eggs/oats/bread combo. Chicken carries both lunch (Ras El Hanout roasted chicken) and dinner (Pollo Asado) with fresh preparations for variety; today's wellness-bar protein option is the Chocolate Cookie Protein Smoothie, used pre-workout in place of an Evolve shake.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: All grab-and-go, no prep needed, to make it easier to actually eat after recently skipping it.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Ras El Hanout roasted chicken as the main with a quinoa-brussels sprouts side for carbs and fiber; a new preparation for variety.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: today's wellness protein smoothie plus turkey.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Pollo asado as the protein-forward main for variety, extra chicken breast and extra pasta for leg-day carbs.
